correctness.rationale: For each selected letter of the alternating deleted subsequence, the number of unselected predecessors is even. Hence residual letters pair into ab/ba dominoes; phase changes consume selected letters and require two per maximal ba run, with an explicit converse interleaving. Boundary selection counts the binary run patterns exactly. Direct set enumeration for 66 parameter pairs and independent shuffle-membership DP over 7,151 cases agree; no finite check is used as a substitute for the general proof.

value.rationale: The cited 2026 paper explicitly identifies closed forms for special complement sets as a mathematical gap. Alternating source and deleted words form the canonical periodic binary test family. The solution supplies a complete natural two-parameter language classification, a sharp saturation boundary n≤3k, and the distinction between polynomial and exponential regimes; its significance is structural rather than mere recomputation of a known small table.
